message:
Fix tic-tac-toe AI + tier detection in game directive

- gameKnowledgeDirective: embed complete working TTT HTML template
  with verified minimax AI so Gemini outputs it verbatim instead of
  generating broken game logic from scratch
- Fix tier detection bug: was checking 'x200'/'x100' etc. but
  function receives internal tier names (opus/opys/opos/opis) —
  added those to the tier checks so difficulty level is correct
